subject: reasoning
question:
If % = divided by,

@ = subtracted from,

$ = multiplied by,

& = added to

Then evaluate:

100 % 5 $ 2 @ 10 & 6 = ?
solution:
BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7751840ca1840d12cadc428f84d30e2cdcd5e7f82d52a57de21f2404c58eed88.png] 

Given equation: 100 % 5 $ 2 @ 10 & 6 = ?

Now, symbols mean: % = ÷, @ = −, $ = ×, & = +

Now, substituting:

⇒ 100 ÷ 5 × 2 − 10 + 6

⇒ 20 × 2 − 10 + 6

⇒ 40 − 10 + 6

⇒ 30 + 6

⇒ 36

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
